title: Academic papers
description: Run actual papers-dl 0.0.25 and pdf2doi 1.5.1 in bundled Python/WASM. DOI, arXiv, publisher and PDF URLs use original provider logic; original requests are archived for offline identifier/title inference.

PAPERSDL_QUERY.description: Optional upstream fetch query: DOI, arXiv identifier, PMID or URL. Empty uses the captured URL with ArchiveBox DOI/arXiv normalization. Upstream errors, including its PMID enum bug, remain explicit.

PAPERSDL_PROVIDERS.description: Upstream selection: all, arxiv, scidb, scihub or comma-separated provider names/mirrors. Provider discovery and pdf2doi validation/search HTTP responses are archived.

PAPERSDL_MAX_REQUESTS.description: Maximum upstream requests, including PDF identifier/title inference.

PAPERSDL_MAX_BYTES.description: Maximum original response bytes acquired by papers-dl.

PAPERSDL_USER_AGENT.description: Optional upstream fetch --user-agent value for provider requests.
